name: Carbon dioxide (CO2)
source: CO2 molar mass 44.009 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (C 12.011, O 15.999 x2). C fraction 12.011/44.009 = 27.2921%.
notes: C is rounded to the nearest microgram; O is set to exactly 1000000000 minus C so the two-element compound closes exactly, the same technique the ledger itself uses (see partition() in core/commodity.ts). No Ash needed: CO2 has no third element to hide.
